scope.preserved: Exact original call IDs, step IDs and full tool arguments; UTF-8 file bytes and absolute paths.
scope.precondition: Destination parent directories exist; both files are completely established by the original Write calls.
scope.checkpoint: Execute Write steps 50 and 55; pause, publish and restore; execute Edit steps 60, 63 and 65.
scope.oracle: Independent byte application of the original arguments; compare both full files before checkpoint, after restore and after edits.
scope.not_tested: Compilation, Rust/Java dependencies, original task outcome, agent task management, original timing, or complete trace compatibility.

exclusion_reason: Explicitly selected file-edit fixture; skipped Bash/Read/TaskUpdate steps are not counted as passing original trace calls.
read_probe_contract: Original Read parameters from steps 13 and 20 can be reapplied as validation-only probes. Their historical results describe an earlier state and must not be reused as the checkpoint oracle. Full-file bytes are authoritative.
